content:
Marta: Pushed a new iterate for the API keys list — compact rows, hover action reveal, and a focused empty state. Figma: https://figma.com/file/new-keyflow
Eli: Hover reveal helps declutter but hides actions for keyboard-only users. Can we make actions visible on focus as well?
Jordan: +1. Also hover reveal currently moves layout when buttons appear (shift-right). Need to avoid layout shift.
Priya: Microcopy: current revoke modal says 'Revoke key'. Suggest: 'Revoke API key — stops all requests immediately. You can create a replacement key afterwards.' Less legalese, clearer action.
Marta: Good call on focus visibility. I'll add :focus-visible styles to show actions and keep them absolutely positioned to prevent shift.
Eli: Accessibility: permission chips lack an aria-label; screen reader reads only color. Make them text+aria-label like "scope: write" and include keyboard focus ring.
DesignReviewBot: Automated check: color contrast for badge red (#c43a2d) vs white fails 4.5:1. Consider a darker red or bold text.
Jordan: Empty state feels lonely in compact layout. Proposal copy: Title 'No API keys yet', body 'Create an API key to start calling Redwood Inference. Use scopes to limit access.' Primary CTA 'Create API key', secondary link 'Scopes & best practices'. Centered + illustrative icon.
Priya: Undo for revoke? Backend has an experimental endpoint but feature flag off. If we show undo copy, gate it behind `revoke_undo`. @ops-bot can you confirm flag?
ops-bot: Flag `revoke_undo` = off in staging; endpoint POST /keys/{id}/undo exists but is experimental.
Eli: So use conditional copy. If flag off, say 'This action cannot be undone.' If on, 'Undo available for 30s.' Also if we show undo, make toast keyboard-focusable and announced via aria-live.
Marta: Action items: 1) Add focus-visible to reveal actions, 2) absolute positioning to prevent layout shift, 3) update revoke copy conditional on flag, 4) replace failing badge color, 5) strengthen empty state copy and center CTA. Will update figma + add QA checklist (keyboard, 200% zoom, screen reader flow).
Jordan: Please add a quick note in PR template so reviewers run axe and manual keyboard checks. Thanks! :thumbsup:
